name: Pipelines - Set the "Run As" identity of the pipeline from the pipeline schedule
description: When automating your Fabric Data Factory pipelines, you will greatly benefit from having the flexibility to set the identity (i.e. user, SPN, workspace identity) of the pipeine at the time of execution. With this feature, you can now set it easily from the scheduler API and scheduler UI.

result.nameEs: Pipelines: definir la identidad de ejecución («Run As») desde la programación
result.descriptionEs: Podrás establecer, al programar la ejecución, con qué identidad se ejecuta el pipeline (usuario, service principal o workspace identity), tanto desde la API como desde la interfaz del programador.
